title: Cherry Blossom Trails of Japan
alt: Cherry trees in full bloom along a Japanese canal
transport: Bullet trains, coaches and guided touring throughout

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Hiroshima and Kyoto
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel with a river outlook and easy transport links

activities.name: Hiroshima and Miyajima by bullet train
activities.description: The bullet train west to the Peace Memorial Park, then the ferry to Miyajima for the floating torii gate.

activities.name: Osaka sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day through the city: Osaka castle and its park, the Dotonbori canal and the market lanes around Kuromon.

activities.name: Kyoto sightseeing tour
activities.description: A guided day in the old capital, taking in the golden pavilion, a Zen garden and the torii gate paths above Fushimi.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Four nights in one hotel, with Hiroshima and Miyajima by bullet train, a city tour and a full day in Kyoto.

stops.name: Nagoya
stops.subtitle: Nagoya to Nara and Nabana no Sato
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Nagoya, close to the station

activities.name: Todai-ji temple and Nara deer park
activities.match: Todai-ji Temple & Nara Deer Park Day Tour
activities.description: The great bronze Buddha inside Todai-ji, then the deer park where the tame sika deer bow for biscuits.

activities.name: Nabana no Sato illumination
activities.description: The flower park near Nagoya, where millions of lights are strung into tunnels and fields once the sun goes down.

program.name: Nagoya
program.description: A night in Nagoya, reached through Nara's temple and deer park, with the Nabana no Sato lights after dark.

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Hakone and Mount Fuji
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel in Ginza, walking distance from the shops

activities.name: Hakone ropeway
activities.description: The cable car over the sulphur vents of Owakudani, with Mount Fuji across the valley when the sky is clear.

activities.name: Lake Ashi cruise
activities.description: A cruise across Lake Ashi past the red torii gate standing in the water at Hakone shrine.

activities.name: Mount Fuji fifth station
activities.description: Up the mountain road to the fifth station at 2,300 metres, where the treeline ends and the climbing trail begins.

activities.name: Tokyo sightseeing with teamLab Planets
activities.description: A guided city day through Meiji shrine and Asakusa, then teamLab Planets, the barefoot digital art museum in Toyosu.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Three nights in Ginza, reached over the Hakone ropeway and Mount Fuji, with a city day, teamLab Planets and a free day.

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Four star hotels, ten included visits and a route timed for the blossom, from Kansai up to Tokyo.
expert.tip: Late March to early April is the window, and it moves north as the trip does. Book early, these dates sell out first.

summary: Nine days timed for the blossom: four nights in Osaka with Hiroshima and Miyajima, a city tour and a Kyoto day, a night in Nagoya via Nara and the Nabana no Sato lights, then three nights in Ginza reached over Hakone and Mount Fuji.
included: Included: 8 nights in four star hotels with daily breakfast; bullet trains and coaches throughout; a guided day to Hiroshima with Miyajima island; a city tour of Osaka; a full day in Kyoto; Todai-ji temple with the Nara deer park; entry to the Nabana no Sato illuminations; the Hakone ropeway, a Lake Ashi cruise and the Mount Fuji fifth station; a guided Tokyo day with teamLab Planets tickets.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
